signatures.description: Implement the BPv7 (RFC 9171) subset needed to run store-and-forward over scheduled contact windows: canonical CBOR primary and canonical blocks with CRC-16/X25 when CRC type is set, fragmentation and reassembly across partial contacts, lifetime expiry evaluated on DTN time (milliseconds since 2000-01-01T00:00:00Z), and custody-transfer signals with retransmission on custody refusal, per-bundle deduplication, and hop-count decrement. Given a JSON scenario (bundles, contact schedule, custody policy, injected bit-flips and replays), emit deterministic JSONL of per-bundle terminal state (DELIVERED, EXPIRED, REASSEMBLY_FAILED, CRC_REJECTED, DEDUP_DROPPED) plus retransmission counts. Encoding must be byte-exact against the supplied golden vectors, including array-length canonicality, block ordering, and CRC bytes.
